OpenMPT Module Decoder

By: Peter

This component decodes modules, or music files combining both samples and sequence data and effects, using libopenmpt. Its version number is usually derived from the associated libopenmpt version, with a plus sign and trailing number if I add any extra commits following a library update. It supports files in the following formats: .MPTM, .MOD, .S3M, .XM, .IT, .669, .AMF, .AMS, .C67, .DBM, .DIGI, .DMF, .DSM, .DTM, .FAR, .IMF, .ICE, .J2B, .M15, .MDL, .MED, .MMS, .MT2, .MTM, .NST, .OKT, .PLM, .PSM, .PT36, .PTM, .SFX, .SFX2, .ST26, .STK, .STM, .STP, .ULT, .WOW, .GDM, .MUS, .FMT, SymMOD, DSym, and .STX. It also supports Ian Luck's .MO3 compressed format with MP3, Ogg Vorbis, or ADPCM samples, and it also supports arbitrary archive formats with the extensions of .MDZ, .MDR, .S3Z, .S3R, .XMZ, .ITZ, or .MPTMZ, assuming foobar2000's Archive Support plugin is installed, or any other archive plugin.

https://lib.openmpt.org/doc/changelog.html

Current version: 0.8.9, released on 2026-09-18

Download

Change log:

  • libopenmpt update.
  • Made recognize alternate extensions for some of the formats: okta, mmd0, mmd1, mmd2, mmd3.

Supported systems: Windows 32-bit, Windows 64-bit, macOS.

Works with foobar2000 v2.0 and newer.
